questions.question: In passé composé, 'manger' (to eat) for 'je' becomes?
questions.explanation: Passé composé = avoir/être + past participle. For 'manger': j'ai mangé (I ate / I have eaten).

questions.question: The auxiliary verb used with 'partir' (to leave) in passé composé is?
questions.explanation: 'Partir' uses être as auxiliary. Verbs of movement (aller, venir, partir, arriver...) use être. Je suis parti(e).

questions.question: {{userName}} writes: 'Nous sommes allés au parc.' Why is 'allés' not 'allé'?
options: 'Aller' uses être and the past participle agrees with the subject (masc. plural)
The -s is always added in passé composé
questions.explanation: With être, the past participle agrees in gender/number with the subject. 'Nous' (masc. plural) → allés (add -s).

questions.question: {{userName}} hears: 'Hier, j'ai vu un film.' What does 'hier' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Hier' means yesterday. Other time expressions: aujourd'hui (today), demain (tomorrow).

questions.question: 'Tu ne viens pas?' means?
questions.explanation: 'Ne...pas' around the verb = negation. 'Tu ne viens pas' = You are not coming.

questions.question: The past participle of 'être' is?
questions.explanation: The past participle of 'être' (to be) is 'été'. Example: J'ai été malade = I was sick / I have been sick.

questions.question: How do you say 'I have not done it' in French?
questions.explanation: Passé composé negation: je + ne + auxiliary + pas + past participle. Je n'ai pas fait = I have not done.

questions.question: 'Il y a' means?
questions.explanation: 'Il y a' = there is / there are. Also used with time: 'il y a deux jours' = two days ago.

questions.question: What is the imparfait ending for 'je' in '-er' verbs?
questions.explanation: Imparfait endings: je -ais, tu -ais, il/elle -ait, nous -ions, vous -iez, ils -aient. Je parlais = I was speaking / I used to speak.

questions.question: The present participle of 'parler' is?
questions.explanation: Present participle is formed by dropping -ons from 'nous' form and adding -ant. Parlons → parlant.

questions.question: 'Depuis quand?' means?
questions.explanation: 'Depuis quand?' = Since when? / How long? Often used with present tense: 'Depuis quand habites-tu ici?' (How long have you lived here?)

questions.question: Which auxiliary verb does 'tomber' (to fall) use in passé composé?
questions.explanation: 'Tomber' uses être. Many verbs of motion and state change use être: aller, venir, partir, arriver, naître, mourir, tomber, etc.
